crossRefs.note: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them…
“ ‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.
For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing…
lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…

translations.web: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—
translations.bsb: or finds lost property and lies about it and swears falsely, or if he commits any such sin that a man might commit—
translations.kjv: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
translations.asv: or have found that which was lost, and deal falsely therein, and swear to a lie; in any of all these things that a man doeth, sinning therein;
